module: Auxiliary controller for the pedestrian acoustic vehicle alerting system (AVAS) of electric vehicles. Plays a "forward" loop in D/S modes, a "reverse" loop in R, and nothing otherwise or above the maximum speed (+1 m/s); the pitch/volume parameter depends on speed.
notes: jbeam keys read in initSounds: forwardSoundEvent ("event:>Engine>Pedestrian Warning>Forward_01"), reverseSoundEvent ("..._Reverse_01"), forwardSoundNode_nodes and reverseSoundNode_nodes (first element = node, 0 otherwise), warningMaxSpeed (50/3.6 m/s), warningVolume (0.5).
Reads electrics.values.gear (gear name) and wheelspeed. The speed CT (ControlTrigger) parameter is linear from 0 to warningMaxSpeed.
reset calls obj:stopSFX on sources that are only created in initSounds (possibly nil if reset is called before).

init.desc: Does nothing (the configuration is read in initSounds).

initSounds.desc: Creates the two looping sound sources and reads the maximum speed and volume. Called by the engine at sound initialization.

reset.desc: Stops both sounds and resets the state to "stopped".

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: chooses the state (forward/reverse/stopped) depending on the gear and speed, plays/stops the sounds and adjusts the speed parameter.
